propositions: Single-pass prepacked FILTER on per-AC evidence packs (grep-at-ref, file_impact slices, cited tests) achieves zero false-PASSes on 5 planted-unmet ACs when constrained to PASS-or-ABSTAIN contract (never FAIL).

Narrowed agentic fallback scoped to ABSTAINed ACs via monkeypatched show_ticket + reduced AC block achieves -26% total tokens (-46% on all-met corpus) vs pure-agentic control while maintaining identical verdicts on all 6 test variants.
AC coverage is bimodal: greppable artifacts (tests, symbols, files) PASS at 80-90%, runtime outcomes and store-side ACs rationally ABSTAIN; filter cost is negligible (0.4% of agentic spend).

Agentic verifier exhibits low-rate false-FAILs on genuinely-met ACs (2/7 in one epic-adv run) and context-sensitive coverage (same pack PASSed/ABSTAINed identically-worded ACs in different tickets), indicating variance-within-design dominates cost deltas ±30%.
Filter adoption requires 8000-char description cap re-check post-reduction, AC-style telemetry to skip filter on runtime-outcome-only tickets, and citations recorded in verdict for auditability.
